concept: Being accountable to a group when your actions affect others (a team project, a group plan)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is part of a group effort where their individual follow-through directly affects the outcome for others
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to handle a moment where they're tempted to let their part slide
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on how their choice would land with the rest of the group

assessment.success_marker: student can describe the real impact of their choice on others, not just on themselves
